home.title: Korea, in Your Language.
home.desc: From the spicy steam rising from a tteokbokki food cart to the serene shadow of Cheomseongdae, which has stood the test of a thousand years, and the sunset that paints the Han River at dusk—Korea is a country brimming with stories that you might easily miss if you only pass through in a hurry. A single piece of kimchi, made with a grandmother’s care, holds the passage of time passed down through generations, and beneath the tiled roofs of hanok houses in narrow alleys, the breath of people from long ago still lingers. We’ve gathered these small stories and translated them into your language, hoping to show you a Korea that’s alive—not just a few photographs. Once you turn the page, you’ll find that your next travel destination has become Korea.
